progression.ryzergen.title: Ryzer Gen: from the ground to the sun
progression.ryzergen.hint: Drag or scroll to move along the line. Click a step to read about it.
progression.ryzergen.column.more_hint: Fusion and the Dyson swarm are still being built.
progression.ryzergen.grid.note: As the control screen shows them: front row at the bottom
progression.ryzergen.mega_drill.headline: Ore from the deep
progression.ryzergen.station.headline: Up to <n>16,012</n> FE/t {power}
progression.ryzergen.breeder.headline: <n>38,000</n> FE/t {power}
progression.ryzergen.fusion.headline: Still being built
progression.ryzergen.swarm.headline: Harvest the sun
progression.ryzergen.iron.info.1: Steel, frames and most early recipes start here.
progression.ryzergen.coal.info.1: Carbon for steel, silicon and graphite.
progression.ryzergen.copper.info.1: Wire: cables, boards and the coolant jacket.
progression.ryzergen.sand.info.1: Silica, for silicon carbide and silicon.
progression.ryzergen.redstone.info.1: Logic for boards, cables and machines.
progression.ryzergen.gold.info.1: Contacts on advanced boards and {speed} Modules.
progression.ryzergen.uranium.info.2: Safe to carry: only running reactors and meltdowns give off {radiation}.
progression.ryzergen.lead.info.1: Shielding: the reactor heart, the Reprocessor and the station's core.
progression.ryzergen.silver.info.1: Soaks up neutrons: the station's <control>Control rods</control>, and silver fittings.
progression.ryzergen.salt.info.1: Lithium for batteries and {tritium}; {sodium} for the breeder.
progression.ryzergen.tungsten.info.1: Melts hotter than any other metal: the Mega Drill's controller, heads and tips.
progression.ryzergen.aluminium.info.1: Mined as bauxite. It cases the lithium in <breeding>target rods</breeding>.
progression.ryzergen.monazite.info.1: A rare earth mineral, deep down: thorium and yttrium.
Your first machine, on furnace fuel: steel and silicon carbide.
progression.ryzergen.graphite.info.1: For fuel, TRISO coatings and the station's {moderator}.
progression.ryzergen.silicon_carbide.inf: Coats TRISO fuel, so each kernel keeps its fission products in.
Smelted from raw uranium. Every {fuel} starts here.
progression.ryzergen.triso.info.1: Uranium kernels coated in graphite and silicon carbide: the microreactor's fuel.
progression.ryzergen.triso.info.2: The Fuel Fabricator makes more per uranium than crafting does.
progression.ryzergen.fuel_core.info.1: <time>40 min</time> of microreactor {fuel}. Spent, it starts the fuel cycle.
progression.ryzergen.microreactor.info.1: Your first real {power}: a heart, <n>2</n> machine units and a coolant jacket.
progression.ryzergen.microreactor.info.2: <n>200</n> FE/t {power} dry, <n>257</n> with {water}. Its {steam} can be piped away.
progression.ryzergen.microreactor.info.3: Spent, its core comes out depleted: the fuel cycle starts here.
progression.ryzergen.intake_pump.info.1: One block above water: <n>100</n> mB/t {water} for <n>10</n> FE/t. Never drains the source.
progression.ryzergen.energy_cable.info.1: Carries {power}. Wrench a side to pull or push.
progression.ryzergen.electric_smelter.in: The alloy smelter on {power}: hot enough for silicon.
progression.ryzergen.silicon.info.1: Made in the electric smelter only: it takes an arc furnace's {heat}.
progression.ryzergen.core_cracker.info.1: Cracks depleted cores: spent kernels out, graphite and steel back.
progression.ryzergen.pool.info.1: Spent {fuel} comes out <heat>hot</heat>. The pool cools it for the Core Cracker and Reprocessor.
progression.ryzergen.reprocessor.info.1: Recovers uranium and plutonium from spent fuel. The plutonium makes MOX rods.
progression.ryzergen.plutonium.info.1: Recovered from spent fuel, most from spent uranium rods. It makes MOX rods.
progression.ryzergen.fuel_fabricator.inf: Presses {fuel}: TRISO, uranium and MOX rods, later breeder fuel.
The recipe with the most ingredients wins.
progression.ryzergen.mega_drill.info.1: A 16-high tower that melts a <n>7 x 7</n> shaft to bedrock. Ores come up; the rest melts away.
progression.ryzergen.mega_drill.info.2: Feed it <n>234</n> Drill Frame and it builds itself. It needs a head, a tungsten tip, {power} and {water}.
progression.ryzergen.mega_drill.info.3: At bedrock it bores on for ore at <n>4×</n> the {power}. Mk II and III heads reach rarer ores.
progression.ryzergen.mega_drill.info.4: A Mk I runs on one microreactor. {power} grows with {speed} squared: a fast deep bore wants fission.
progression.ryzergen.assembler.info.1: An open robot cell that crafts any crafting-table recipe. Nine patterns take turns.
progression.ryzergen.assembler.info.2: Feed it <n>25</n> frames and an arm and it builds itself. Set a pattern with the items, then pipe them in.
progression.ryzergen.assembler.info.3: The arm lays each part where the recipe puts it. A red fixture shows what it waits for.
progression.ryzergen.uranium_rod.info.1: <n>1,000</n> FE/t {heat} for <time>30 min</time>. Spent, it gives plutonium for MOX.
progression.ryzergen.mox_rod.info.1: Twice uranium's {heat}, for <time>2 h</time>: the reward for closing the fuel cycle.
progression.ryzergen.control_rod.info.1: <n>-35%</n> {heat} beside it: trims a station layout that runs too hot.
progression.ryzergen.station.info.1: Tier 3's power station. Plan its <n>5 x 5</n> core: {fuel}, {moderator}, {control} and {coolant}.
progression.ryzergen.station.info.2: {coolant} is local: each rod's {heat} goes to the coolant beside it.
progression.ryzergen.station.info.4: It drinks {water}: feed it with intake pumps.
progression.ryzergen.lithium_extractor.i: Salt and {water} into lithium: LFP racks now, {tritium} later.
progression.ryzergen.container_battery.i: Grid-scale {energy}: a container of LFP racks, built round its controller.
progression.ryzergen.electrorefiner.info: Tier 4's molten salt cell: <n>1,500</n> FE/t {power} every tick, or no progress.
It recovers the breeder's fuel from spent MOX, and makes {sodium} from salt.
progression.ryzergen.transuranic.info.1: Plutonium, americium and curium from spent MOX: the breeder's {fuel}.
progression.ryzergen.sodium.info.1: The breeder's {coolant}: it carries far more {heat} than water. <n>4,000</n> mB fills the loop.
progression.ryzergen.breeder_fuel.info.1: The only fuel that starts a breeder: its fast neutrons burn the transuranics.
progression.ryzergen.uranium_blanket.inf: A blanket round the breeder's fuel: it breeds plutonium, for MOX rods.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.1: Tier 4: a {sodium}-cooled fast reactor that burns the transuranics in spent MOX.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.2: Its fuel makes more neutrons than it needs. Blankets round it catch the spare ones and become new fuel.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.3: Uranium breeds plutonium for MOX rods, thorium breeds U-233 rods; later, lithium breeds {tritium} for fusion.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.4: {sodium} cools the whole core: set the pumps to carry the {heat}, with little to spare.
progression.ryzergen.tritium.info.1: A lithium blanket in the breeder breeds {tritium}, the fuel that starts fusion.
Splits monazite into thorium, for the breeder's blankets, and yttrium.
progression.ryzergen.u233_rod.info.1: A thorium blanket in the breeder breeds U-233, half as fast as uranium breeds plutonium.
progression.ryzergen.u233_rod.info.2: A U-233 rod: <n>2,500</n> FE/t {heat}, the hottest station fuel, for <time>1 h</time>.
progression.ryzergen.fusion.info.1: Tier 5: a tokamak on {tritium}. Still being built.
progression.ryzergen.swarm.info.1: Tier 6: a Dyson swarm round a walkable sun. The end of the line.
progression.ryzergen.microreactor.spoile: It costs <n>2×</n> {water} and <n>+30%</n> burn. Out of water: {meltdown} in <time>9 s</time>.
Excess power set to Dump keeps burning {fuel} into depleted cores: food for the fuel cycle.
progression.ryzergen.reprocessor.spoiler: One Reprocessor and one Fuel Fabricator keep up with a whole station.
<n>3</n> spent uranium rods give one MOX rod's plutonium.
progression.ryzergen.station.spoiler.1: Overdrive: about <n>+50%</n> {power}. Keep every {fuel} channel filled, or the flux tilts.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.spoiler.1: Most power: 38,000 FE/t {power} at 100% flow, from 100,000 FE/t {heat}, the loop's limit.
gui.ryzergen.steady.hint: Keep it running: a stop costs a quarter of the streak
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.5: No assembly may pass <n>13,000</n> FE/t {heat}: spread the fuel among blankets.
progression.ryzergen.breeder.info.6: It needs spent MOX to stay fuelled: keep your station running.
It cracks monazite with {sodium}, at <n>2,000</n> FE/t {power} every tick.
